summary: The base reproduces the reported mismatch: the actual KVCacheConfigurator cap path computes 9 effective requests from max_running_requests=32, max_mamba_cache_size=47, and five Mamba state slots per request, while /server_info (and therefore /get_server_info) has no top-level effective_max_running_requests. At the exact candidate commit, both HTTP aliases and Engine.get_server_info retain the requested max_running_requests and expose the scheduler's post-sizing effective value. The candidate regression suite and independent original-contract/adversarial cases passed. This is a full fix for the requested introspection field, not merely test hardening. No native source changed.

The actual checked-out resolver returned 9 for requested 32, max_mamba_cache_size 47, and ratio 5, reproducing the issue's cap calculation. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-432e800daec0/base-cache-cap.txt

Independently verified requested 32/effective 9, unset requested/effective 47, heterogeneous DP states selecting the restrictive value 9, omission when all runtime values are absent, partial-state behavior, and HTTP/Engine parity. remaining_limitations: No native files differ between base and candidate, so a native rebuild was neither required nor applicable. Imports were confirmed from /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py and /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py. The available GPU is AMD MI350X/gfx950 rather than the reporter's NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada, and no matching 27B hybrid-model weights were prepared, so an end-to-end launch of that exact model/architecture was not performed. The control-plane fix was instead connected to the actual cache-cap resolver and scheduler state contract, then tested through both public implementations. The candidate reports a known value when only a subset of DP state dictionaries contain the field; normal get_internal_state responses are expected to include every scheduler value, but degraded partial-state behavior was not specified by the issue. Raw evidence is retained under /job/review-evidence-j-432e800daec0. Source paths reviewed: python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/kv_cache_configurator.py, python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py, python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py, and python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/engine.py. Native path: none.
